verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents an Event Webhook that posts email event data to a URL you control, so a developer can capture delivery events and build their own history. The pack does not explicitly show open or click tracking, and it shows no API for querying a per-message event history. The Deliverability Insights material describes an in-app dashboard of aggregate performance, not a per-message lookup API. Missing for 10: explicit open/click tracking documentation, a per-message event or activity query API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
